test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The branches of the tree __is__ very long.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. are .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"The branches"**, which is plural.
 
• In English, a plural subject must be followed by a plural verb.
 
• The correct form of the verb to use with a plural subject in the present tense is **"are"**.

Correct sentence: *The branches of the tree **are** very long*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**

 
 
• Singular subjects take singular verbs.
 
• Plural subjects take plural verbs.
 
• Example: The cat runs fast. (singular) / The cats run fast. (plural)
